answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the anchor until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sonnet of the next round. Written in a factual sentences, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
